title: Trade-off between predictability and quantum coherence for multi-path interferometry and its operational interpretation
summary: The complementarity principle is a cornerstone of quantum mechanics. In this work, we investigate a complementarity relation between the predictability and quantum coherence, respectively, representing the particle-like and wave-like behaviour in wave--particle duality, in a multi-path setup. We introduce a basis-dependent predictability defined by the Bures distance between the state dephased in the chosen basis and the maximally mixed state.
